data.name: Omnicore
data.detailed_description:
Mine deep. Upgrade fast. Survive the next wave.

Omnicore is a 3D roguelike mining survival game where every run is a balance between greed and danger. Dig through destructible underground terrain, gather valuable resources, upgrade your equipment, and return before enemy waves overwhelm your base.

Each trip underground is a choice: push deeper for better rewards, or retreat before it is too late. Use your resources to grow stronger, improve your defenses, and prepare for increasingly dangerous attacks.

Key Features

Dig through a procedurally generated mine — carve your own path underground and search for valuable resources.

Balance risk and reward — stay underground longer for better loot, but risk missing the next enemy wave.

Defend your base — return to the surface and survive waves of attackers.

Upgrade between waves — improve your mining drill, carry capacity, weapons, mobility, and defenses.

Discover new opportunities each run — explore different mining paths, resource layouts, and upgrade choices.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 460 or equivalent with Vulkan support
  • Storage: 2 GB GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Preliminary requirements. Vulkan-compatible graphics card required. Requirements may be updated after further testing.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for smoother 1080p gameplay. Final requirements may change after optimization and hardware testing.
